purpose: Measure task outcomes and visual usefulness independently of glasspring's own rule compliance
confirmatory_use: These prompts are public. For a confirmatory held-out study, create a separate task set that was kept out of skill development until generation is complete; otherwise label results exploratory.
controls: same user brief and source assets
no access to the other condition's outputs
capture failures and total elapsed time

tasks.brief: Responsive incident dashboard for on-call engineers. Filter logs by severity, pause the stream, show loading and empty results.
Team analytics pricing page with monthly and annual billing. Annual plan is 20 percent cheaper and shows the total due.
outcomes: billing switch changes displayed amount and period
primary CTA has a meaningful destination or explicit demo state

tasks.brief: Coffee shop landing page using the supplied cream and terracotta brand palette. Preserve brand identity.
Public-service appointment form with errors, confirmation, keyboard navigation and no decorative animation.
Add a settings page to the supplied existing component library without redesigning its visual system.
Three-page equipment-rental site with home, prices and journal using shared branding and working navigation.
outcomes: three page types use suitable distinct layouts

blinding: Randomize output labels and order after generation. Keep assignment key away from judges. Record screenshots at fixed sizes and test interactive outputs.
primary_visual_outcome: Blinded pairwise preference between matched outputs, judged by independent people in randomized order
judges: At least two independent human reviewers, unaware of condition and independent of generation. Automated or model-based scores may supplement but do not replace human review.
analysis: Predeclare endpoints before generation. Publish all 36 outputs, failures, paired task differences with uncertainty intervals, judge disagreement, and elapsed time. Treat this small public set as a pilot. No points merely for using tokens, glass, or obeying a style ban. Do not claim a general improvement if results are task-dependent or inconclusive.
